instructions: 只編輯 target_zh_TW 與 translator_note。空白 target 匯出時保留英文；這份 JSON 不是遊戲原生格式。

entries.source:
THE GATHERING STORM
Prepare for a showdown between
the Rebellion and the Empire.
entries.target_zh_TW:
風暴將至
反抗軍與帝國之間的
決戰即將展開。

entries.source:
Tour of Duty III
THE GATHERING STORM
entries.target_zh_TW:
第三服役期
風暴將至

entries.source:
Having discovered the existence of the DEATH STAR project, the Rebel Alliance prepares for its greatest challenge.  With the technical plans in the hands of Princess Leia, the Alliance gathers its forces to destroy the Empire's ultimate weapon.

The DEATH STAR, nearing completion at a secret Imperial base, is being prepared for its reign of terror.
entries.target_zh_TW:
得知死星計畫的存在後，反抗軍聯盟正準備迎接最嚴峻的挑戰。技術藍圖已在莉亞公主手中，聯盟正集結兵力，準備摧毀帝國的終極武器。

即將在帝國秘密基地完工的死星，正準備展開它的恐怖統治。

entries.source:
Guard the Freighter
Sidral II until the
Corvette Frazier has
transferred its
cargo.
entries.target_zh_TW:
守衛貨船
西卓二號，
直到護衛艦弗雷澤號
完成貨物
轉運。

entries.source: [[Protect ]]military rendezvous from attack by Imperial fighters.
entries.target_zh_TW: [[保護]]軍事會合點，抵禦帝國戰機的攻擊。

entries.source: [[Intercept]] Imperial TIE Fighter and TIE Bomber Squadrons.
entries.target_zh_TW: [[攔截]]帝國鈦戰機與鈦轟炸機中隊。

entries.source: With the news that the Empire is building a massive new type of secret weapon, [[High Command]] is anxious that the Alliance prepare itself for a large, decisive battle.  Although the location of the [[Death]] [[Star]] is still a mystery, efforts are being made to discover what military contractors are involved in its construction.$  The first breakthrough in this effort has been the capture of a [[Freighter ]]loaded with the latest
entries.target_zh_TW: 得知帝國正在建造一種龐大的新型秘密武器後，[[最高指揮部]]急於讓聯盟做好準備，迎接一場大規模的決戰。儘管[[死]][[星]]的位置仍是個謎，我們正努力查出有哪些軍事承包商參與了它的建造。$  這項行動的第一個突破，是俘獲了一艘[[貨船]]，船上滿載最新型的

entries.source: military hardware.  It is hoped that an analysis of this equipment will reveal more about who is building the Death Star.$  Your mission is to stand guard over the Freighter [[Sidral II]] and wait until the Corvette [[Frazier]] has loaded the captured equipment.
entries.target_zh_TW: 軍事裝備。我們希望藉由分析這批裝備，查出更多死星建造者的線索。$  你的任務是守衛貨船[[西卓二號]]，直到護衛艦[[弗雷澤號]]裝載完這批俘獲的裝備。

entries.source: The freighter and the corvette have completed their rendezvous
entries.target_zh_TW: 貨船與護衛艦已完成會合

entries.source: Both ships have hyperdrived to safety
entries.target_zh_TW: 兩艘船艦均已躍入超空間脫險

entries.source:
Assist your flight
leader in destroying
an Imperial Repair Dock 
and the surrounding ships.
entries.target_zh_TW:
協助你的長機
摧毀一座
帝國維修船塢
及周圍的船艦。

entries.source: Your flight leader [[Red One]] will attack the [[Corvette]] and [[Repair Dock]].
entries.target_zh_TW: 你的長機[[紅色一號]]將攻擊[[護衛艦]]與[[維修船塢]]。

entries.source: You are to destroy all the [[smaller ships]] and any defenses in the area.
entries.target_zh_TW: 你負責摧毀該區域所有[[較小的船艦]]及任何防禦設施。

entries.source: Part of the shipment of military equipment captured in the last operation passed through an Imperial repair facility near [[Coruscant]].  High Command believes that an attack on this base could be devastating.  Knocking out this facility will cripple the infrastructure that services the starships the [[Death Star]] project depends on.$  Your mission is to completely destroy this facility.
entries.target_zh_TW: 上一次行動中俘獲的那批軍事裝備，有一部分曾經過[[科羅森]]附近的一座帝國維修設施。最高指揮部相信，攻擊這座基地可能造成毀滅性的打擊。摧毀這座設施，將癱瘓為[[死星]]計畫所需星艦提供維修的基礎設施。$  你的任務是徹底摧毀這座設施。

entries.source: THE REPAIR AREA HAS BEEN DESTROYED

An Imperial Transport
carrying military advisors 
has been disabled.  Lead 
your Y-wing squadron to
oversee its capture.
entries.target_zh_TW:
一艘載有軍事顧問的
帝國運輸艦
已被癱瘓。率領
你的 Y翼戰機中隊
掩護俘獲行動。

entries.source: An Imperial Military [[Transport ]]is disabled and stranded.
entries.target_zh_TW: 一艘帝國軍用[[運輸艦]]已被癱瘓，困在原地。

entries.source: Protect the [[Shuttle]] [[Hunter]] while it boards and captures the [[Transport]].
entries.target_zh_TW: 保護[[穿梭機]][[獵人號]]登艦並俘獲該[[運輸艦]]。

entries.source: [[Special Forces Command]] has succeeded in sabotaging an important military Transport carrying [[Imperial Military Advisors]].[[ ]] It is hoped that these high ranking officers have been assigned to the [[Death Star ]]project and have knowledge about it.$  You are to lead your [[Y-wing]] Squadron to oversee its capture. Stay with the captured Transport until it makes it to safety aboard the Alliance Frigate [[Inad]].
entries.target_zh_TW: [[特種部隊司令部]]已成功破壞一艘載有[[帝國軍事顧問]]的重要軍用運輸艦。[[ ]]我們希望這些高階軍官曾被派往[[死星]]計畫，並掌握相關情報。$  你將率領你的[[Y翼戰機]]中隊掩護俘獲行動。請隨同被俘的運輸艦，直到它安全抵達聯盟巡防艦[[伊納德號]]。

entries.source: The Captured Transport has reached the safety of FRG Inad
entries.target_zh_TW: 被俘的運輸艦已安全抵達巡防艦伊納德號

entries.source:
Defend the Calamari
Cruiser Defiance from
a surprise attack by
the Imperial Star
Destroyer Immortal.
entries.target_zh_TW:
保衛卡拉馬里
巡洋艦不屈號，
抵禦帝國滅星者
不朽號的
突襲。

entries.source: The Star Destroyer [[Immortal ]]has just ended its hyperdrive jump next to the Cruiser[[ Defiance]].  Our cruiser is stationed above [[Bestine]], site of an important base.$  You will be one of the few starfighters that can scramble to defend the ship.  Hold off[[ ]]the [[TIE Bombers]] until the Defiance can hyperdrive to safety.  Its jump coordinates will be downloaded to your R2 for your return.
entries.target_zh_TW: 滅星者[[不朽號]]剛結束超空間躍遷，出現在巡洋艦[[不屈號]]旁邊。我們的巡洋艦駐守在[[貝斯汀]]上空，那裡是一座重要基地的所在地。$  你將是少數能緊急升空保衛該艦的星際戰機之一。擋住[[ ]][[鈦轟炸機]]，直到不屈號能躍入超空間脫險。它的躍遷座標將下載到你的 R2 機器人，供你返航使用。

entries.source: With your [[X-wing]] defend[[ ]]our command ship,[[ ]]the Calamari Cruiser[[ Defiance]].
entries.target_zh_TW: 駕駛你的[[X翼戰機]]保衛[[ ]]我們的指揮艦：[[ ]]卡拉馬里巡洋艦[[不屈號]]。

entries.source: The STD [[Immortal ]]has just entered our sector and is deploying [[TIEs]].
entries.target_zh_TW: 滅星者[[不朽號]]剛進入我們的星區，正在派出[[鈦戰機]]。

entries.source: The Defiance has made it to safety
The jump coordinates have been fed to your computer
entries.target_zh_TW: 躍遷座標已輸入你的電腦

entries.source:
Lead an attack on an
Imperial Corvette to
capture members of the 
Death Star design team.
entries.target_zh_TW:
率隊攻擊一艘
帝國護衛艦，
俘獲死星設計團隊的
成員。

entries.source: Part of the Death Star design team is on their way to a rendezvous with the Star Destroyer [[Immortal]].
entries.target_zh_TW: 死星設計團隊的部分成員正在前往與滅星者[[不朽號]]會合的途中。

entries.source: With them is a squad of [[Stormtroopers]] holding them as virtual prisoners on their [[Corvette]].
entries.target_zh_TW: 與他們同行的是一隊[[風暴兵]]，實際上將他們當成囚犯看守在[[護衛艦]]上。

entries.source: There are [[Gunboat]] and [[TIE Fighter]] escorts. These will be attacked and drawn off by the [[X-wings]].
entries.target_zh_TW: 他們有[[砲艇]]與[[鈦戰機]]護航，這些護航機將由[[X翼戰機]]負責攻擊並引開。

entries.source: You will lead the capture effort. Your task will be to disable the [[Corvette]] carrying the design team.
entries.target_zh_TW: 你將率領俘獲行動，任務是癱瘓載有設計團隊的[[護衛艦]]。

entries.source: A [[Rescue Shuttle]] will drop out of hyperspace as soon as the Corvette has been disabled.
entries.target_zh_TW: 護衛艦一被癱瘓，[[救援穿梭機]]就會脫離超空間抵達。

entries.source: Protect the [[Shuttle]] as it makes its escape back into hyperspace.
entries.target_zh_TW: 在[[穿梭機]]脫逃返回超空間時保護它。

entries.source: If you have time before the Immortal's[[ TIE interceptors]] arrive, you may attack the other craft.
entries.target_zh_TW: 若在不朽號的[[鈦攔截機]]抵達前還有時間，你可以攻擊其他船艦。

entries.source: The Military Advisors captured in the Corellian system were unable to provide many details of the Death Star Project except that the design team was led by [[Bevel Lemelisk]].  They also knew that part of his team had recently travelled to [[Coruscant]] to meet with Imperial Grand Moff [[Tarkin]].$  High Command believes it is important to try to capture the design team.
entries.target_zh_TW: 在柯瑞利亞星系俘獲的軍事顧問無法提供死星計畫的太多細節，只知道設計團隊由[[貝佛·雷梅利斯克]]領導。他們也知道，他的部分團隊成員最近曾前往[[科羅森]]，與帝國的[[塔金]]總督會面。$  最高指揮部認為，設法俘獲這支設計團隊至關重要。

entries.source: Their loss can only slow the progress on the Death Star.  More importantly they will help us interpret the technical readouts en route to us with Princess Leia.$  Your mission is to lead this daring attack on the Imperial Corvette and capture the design team.
entries.target_zh_TW: 失去他們只會拖慢死星的進度。更重要的是，他們能協助我們解讀正由莉亞公主送來的技術資料。$  你的任務是率領這次對帝國護衛艦的大膽攻擊，俘獲設計團隊。

entries.source: The Design team has been captured

Lead an assault on
the Imperial base
near Kalla VII and
destroy all equipment
and supply ships.
entries.target_zh_TW:
率隊突擊
卡拉七號星附近的
帝國基地，
摧毀所有裝備
與補給船。

entries.source: Attack Imperial supply and repair base. Destroy [[containers]] and [[mines]].
entries.target_zh_TW: 攻擊帝國補給與維修基地。摧毀[[貨櫃]]與[[太空水雷]]。

entries.source: Attack any Imperial [[Freighters]] that approach the base.
entries.target_zh_TW: 攻擊任何接近基地的帝國[[貨船]]。

entries.source: High Command has demanded that all units search for evidence of where the [[Death Star]] is being constructed.  Our intelligence has identified a key supply and repair base near [[Kalla VII]] being used by starships going to and from the Death Star project.  Their exact destination remains a mystery.$  General Dodonna has devised a brilliant plan to learn where the Death Star Project is located by capturing an Imperial starship intact.
entries.target_zh_TW: 最高指揮部已下令所有單位搜尋[[死星]]建造地點的線索。我們的情報單位已查出[[卡拉七號星]]附近有一座重要的補給與維修基地，往返死星計畫的星艦都會使用它。它們的確切目的地仍是個謎。$  多唐納將軍擬定了一項絕妙的計畫：完整俘獲一艘帝國星艦，藉此查出死星計畫的所在位置。

entries.source: His plan calls for attacking the supply base at [[Kalla VII]] and rendering it unusable, so that when the next Imperial starship arrives for repairs it will become stranded.$  Your mission is to lead the initial assault on the base near [[Kalla VII]] and destroy all equipment and any supply ships.
entries.target_zh_TW: 他的計畫是攻擊[[卡拉七號星]]的補給基地，使其無法運作，如此一來，下一艘前來維修的帝國星艦就會被困在那裡。$  你的任務是率領對[[卡拉七號星]]附近基地的首波突擊，摧毀所有裝備及任何補給船。

entries.source: The supply area has been destroyed
The resupply freighters have been destroyed

entries.target_zh_TW: 摧毀普萊姆號的護航艦

entries.source:
Eliminate the Frigate
Priam's escorts in order 
to leave the Frigate 
vulnerable to capture.
entries.target_zh_TW:
清除巡防艦
普萊姆號的護航艦，
讓該巡防艦
毫無防備、可被俘獲。
>任務 7：摧毀普萊姆號的護航艦

entries.source: Attack the ships providing escort for the Frigate [[Priam]].
entries.target_zh_TW: 攻擊為巡防艦[[普萊姆號]]護航的船艦。

entries.source: The [[A-wings ]]will concentrate on destroying the TIE fighters.
entries.target_zh_TW: [[A翼戰機]]將集中火力摧毀鈦戰機。

entries.source: Your [[Y-wings]] will try to destroy the [[Corvette]] escort.
entries.target_zh_TW: 你的[[Y翼戰機]]將設法摧毀擔任護航的[[護衛艦]]。

entries.source: Beware of the minefield that is surrounding the Frigate [[Priam]].
entries.target_zh_TW: 小心巡防艦[[普萊姆號]]周圍的雷區。

entries.source: The Frigate[[ Priam]] has arrived at the Imperial supply base near [[Kalla VII]] needing repairs.  Because of the destruction of the base by our last operation, the Priam is stranded, unable to go into hyperspace.$  This is just the opportunity that General Dodonna has hoped for to seize an Imperial starship.$  Your mission is to clear out the Priam's escort and to leave it defenseless.
entries.target_zh_TW: 巡防艦[[普萊姆號]]抵達[[卡拉七號星]]附近的帝國補給基地，需要維修。由於該基地已在我們上一次行動中被摧毀，普萊姆號因此受困，無法進入超空間。$  這正是多唐納將軍期待已久、奪取帝國星艦的良機。$  你的任務是清除普萊姆號的護航艦，使其毫無防備。

entries.source: The FRG's defences have been eliminated
entries.target_zh_TW: 巡防艦的防衛力量已被清除

entries.source:
Provide cover for
both waves of Y-wing groups
as they disable the Imperial
Frigate Priam.  Rebel 
Commandos will then board
and capture it.
entries.target_zh_TW:
掩護兩波
Y翼戰機編隊
癱瘓帝國巡防艦
普萊姆號。反抗軍
突擊隊隨後將登艦
並俘獲該艦。

entries.source: Your [[A-wing]] is to destroy mines and provide cover for the Y-wings that are disabling the Frigate [[Priam]].
entries.target_zh_TW: 你的[[A翼戰機]]負責摧毀太空水雷，並掩護正在癱瘓巡防艦[[普萊姆號]]的 Y翼戰機。

entries.source: Protect our boarding craft as they storm the Frigate[[ Priam ]]and capture it.
entries.target_zh_TW: 在我方登艦艇突入巡防艦[[普萊姆號]]並將其俘獲時提供保護。

entries.source: During the last operation the Frigate [[Priam]] was stripped of her escort.  Except for a few small groups of TIEs and some mines she has deployed around her, the [[Priam]] is virtually defenseless.$  General Dodonna has ordered that our Special Forces Command lead a "board and capture" operation against the Priam.  Your mission is to fly cover in an [[A-wing]] during the disabling and capture of the Priam.
entries.target_zh_TW: 在上一次行動中，巡防艦[[普萊姆號]]的護航艦已被清除。除了幾小群鈦戰機及它在周圍布下的一些太空水雷之外，[[普萊姆號]]幾乎毫無防備。$  多唐納將軍已下令由我們的特種部隊司令部主導一場針對普萊姆號的「登艦俘獲」行動。你的任務是駕駛[[A翼戰機]]，在癱瘓與俘獲普萊姆號的過程中提供掩護。

entries.source: The Frigate Priam has been secured
entries.target_zh_TW: 巡防艦普萊姆號已被控制

entries.source: All Imperial personnel have been subdued
entries.target_zh_TW: 所有帝國人員均已制伏

entries.source: The Priam's captain has surrendered control to our forces
entries.target_zh_TW: 普萊姆號艦長已向我軍交出控制權

entries.source:
Provide cover for
the Y-wings attempting to
recover the Corvettes
Ethar I and II.  These ships
must be recovered from
the Empire!
entries.target_zh_TW:
掩護正設法
奪回護衛艦伊薩一號
與二號的 Y翼戰機。
這兩艘船艦
必須從帝國手中
奪回！

entries.source: Two Corellian Corvettes, Ethar I and II are being [[repaired]] by the Empire.
entries.target_zh_TW: 兩艘柯瑞利亞護衛艦伊薩一號與二號正由帝國[[維修]]中。

entries.source: Destroy the [[Gunboat]] escorts and keep an eye on other enemy fighters.
entries.target_zh_TW: 摧毀護航的[[砲艇]]，並留意其他敵方戰機。

entries.source: Support the [[Y-Wing]] Squadrons in disabling the captured Corvettes.
entries.target_zh_TW: 支援[[Y翼戰機]]中隊癱瘓被俘的護衛艦。

entries.source: Protect our [[Rescue Shuttles]] while they recapture both starships.
entries.target_zh_TW: 在[[救援穿梭機]]重新奪回兩艘星艦時保護它們。

entries.source: The capture of the Frigate[[ Priam]] revealed that the construction site of the [[Death Star]] was located in the [[Horuz]] system near the prison planet [[Despayre]]. Two Alliance Corellian [[Corvettes]] were dispatched to the Horuz system to investigate and found only the shattered remnants of the planet Despayre and no trace of the Death Star.$  Once again it appeared that the Empire had remained one step ahead
entries.target_zh_TW: 俘獲巡防艦[[普萊姆號]]後，我們得知[[死星]]的建造地點位於監獄行星[[絕望星]]附近的[[霍魯茲]]星系。兩艘聯盟柯瑞利亞[[護衛艦]]奉命前往霍魯茲星系調查，卻只發現絕望星破碎的殘骸，死星早已不見蹤影。$  帝國似乎又一次比

entries.source: of the Alliance.  To make matters worse, Imperial forces were lying in wait for our [[Corvettes]] to ambush and capture them.$  Your mission is to spearhead the recovery effort.  These Corvettes are vital elements of the [[Alliance]] [[Fleet]].  They must be recovered!  Fly your [[X-wing]] to protect the board and capture craft.
entries.target_zh_TW: 聯盟搶先一步。更糟的是，帝國部隊早已埋伏，等著伏擊並俘獲我們的[[護衛艦]]。$  你的任務是擔任奪回行動的先鋒。這些護衛艦是[[聯盟]][[艦隊]]的重要成員，必須奪回！駕駛你的[[X翼戰機]]保護登艦俘獲艇。
這場空戰打得漂亮，紅色二號！

entries.source: Both Corellian Corvettes have been recovered
entries.target_zh_TW: 兩艘柯瑞利亞護衛艦均已奪回

entries.source: See you back at the Defiance!

Protect our hidden
cache of weapons from
Imperial attack.
entries.target_zh_TW:
保護我們隱藏的
武器儲藏點，
抵禦帝國攻擊。

entries.source: Protect [[military supply cache]] from Imperial attack.
entries.target_zh_TW: 保護[[軍事補給儲藏點]]，抵禦帝國攻擊。

entries.source: [[High Command]] has sent out a priority alert to all military bases that Imperial Forces are on the move.  The new super weapon, the [[Death Star]], has been completed and is starting its campaign of terror!  Imperial Forces are on the attack in all sectors.  The Emperor seems determined to exterminate us once and for all.$ [[ ]]Your mission is to guard a hidden cache of weapons.
entries.target_zh_TW: [[最高指揮部]]已向所有軍事基地發出優先警報：帝國軍正在調動。新型超級武器[[死星]]已經完工，並開始了它的恐怖行動！帝國軍正在各星區發動攻勢。皇帝似乎決心要將我們一舉殲滅。$ [[ ]]你的任務是守衛一處隱藏的武器儲藏點。

entries.source: Wait for [[A-wing Blue]] squadron to relieve you.
entries.target_zh_TW: 等待[[A翼藍色]]中隊前來接替你。

entries.source: ENOUGH VITAL CONTAINERS HAVE BEEN SAVED
entries.target_zh_TW: 足夠的重要貨櫃已經保住

entries.source: YOU HAVE BEEN RELIEVED BY BLUE SQUADRON
entries.target_zh_TW: 藍色中隊已前來接替你

entries.source:
Intercept and destroy
the attacking Imperial
ships.  Provide cover
until the Independence
has escaped.
entries.target_zh_TW:
攔截並摧毀
來襲的帝國艦艇。
提供掩護，
直到獨立號
脫險為止。

entries.source: The Alliance Flagship [[Independence]] is under attack and needs our help!
entries.target_zh_TW: 聯盟旗艦[[獨立號]]遭受攻擊，需要我們的協助！

entries.source: Ward off the Imperial Forces until the [[Independence]] has escaped.
entries.target_zh_TW: 擊退帝國部隊，直到[[獨立號]]脫險。

entries.source: The Cruiser [[Independence]], carrying members of the [[High Command ]]is under attack from Imperial forces near Bestine.  [[Mon Mothma]] thinks that this attack is the opening phase of the Empire's grand offensive.[[  ]]High Command[[ ]]must escape to [[Yavin]] to coordinate the Alliance defense.$  All available Rebel forces are being scrambled to aid the Independence.  Your mission is to fend off the Imperial attack.
entries.target_zh_TW: 載有[[最高指揮部]]成員的巡洋艦[[獨立號]]正在貝斯汀附近遭到帝國部隊攻擊。[[蒙·莫瑟瑪]]認為，這次攻擊是帝國大規模攻勢的序幕。[[  ]]最高指揮部[[ ]]必須撤往[[雅文]]，以統籌聯盟的防禦。$  所有可用的反抗軍部隊都已緊急出動支援獨立號。你的任務是擊退帝國的攻擊。

entries.source: Again you have helped save the day!
The Independence is safe, return home to the Defiance
entries.target_zh_TW: 獨立號已經安全，返回不屈號

entries.source:
Use your X-wing to
destroy the Comm Sat
that is coordinating
the defenses of the
Death Star.  Destroy
as many ships as
possible.
entries.target_zh_TW:
駕駛你的 X翼戰機
摧毀負責協調
死星防禦的
通訊衛星。
盡可能摧毀
更多的
敵艦。

entries.source: Escorted by [[A-Wings]], you are to attack the [[Death Star's]] defenses.
entries.target_zh_TW: 在[[A翼戰機]]護航下，你將攻擊[[死星]]的防禦力量。

entries.source: Destroy the [[Comm Sat]] so that reinforcements cannot be called in.
entries.target_zh_TW: 摧毀[[通訊衛星]]，使敵軍無法召來增援。

entries.source: This will leave the [[Death Star]] open to a direct attack by starfighters.
entries.target_zh_TW: 這將使[[死星]]暴露在星際戰機的直接攻擊之下。

entries.source: The Empire has discovered the main Alliance base on the fourth moon of [[Yavin ]]and has sent the Death Star to destroy it. Our fleet has gathered to defend our base and to destroy the [[Death Star]].$  Our scientists have concluded that the best tactic against the Death Star is to use our small, fast [[starfighters]] rather than send our larger starships.$
entries.target_zh_TW: 帝國發現了聯盟位於[[雅文]]第四衛星的主要基地，並派出死星前來摧毀它。我們的艦隊已集結，準備保衛基地並摧毀[[死星]]。$  我們的科學家斷定，對付死星的最佳戰術是動用我們小巧而快速的[[星際戰機]]，而非派出大型星艦。$

entries.source: Your mission is to clear a path to the Death Star by disrupting her escort force.  Use your X-wing to destroy the [[Comm Sat]] that is being used to coordinate their defenses.  Take out as many of the screening ships as possible to weaken the Death Star's protection.$  Good Luck!
entries.target_zh_TW: 你的任務是擾亂死星的護航兵力，為攻擊死星開出一條路。駕駛你的 X翼戰機摧毀用來協調敵方防禦的[[通訊衛星]]。盡可能消滅掩護艦艇，以削弱死星的防護。$  祝你好運！

entries.source: The Comm Sat has been destroyed
Your have prepared the way for our attack on the Death Star
entries.target_zh_TW: 你已為我們對死星的攻擊鋪好了路

entries.source:
Clear the Death Star
surface defenses that
surround a Nav Buoy
in preparation for
a Trench Run.
entries.target_zh_TW:
清除死星表面
導航浮標周圍的
防禦設施，
為溝槽突襲
做好準備。

entries.source: Engage any TIE Fighters encountered on your way to the [[Nav Buoy]].
entries.target_zh_TW: 在前往[[導航浮標]]途中，與遭遇的任何鈦戰機交戰。

entries.source: Destroy all [[Turbolaser Gun Towers]] surrounding the [[Nav Buoy]].
entries.target_zh_TW: 摧毀[[導航浮標]]周圍所有的[[渦輪雷射砲塔]]。

entries.source: Destroy all [[Hangar Ports]] from which the TIE Fighters are launched.
entries.target_zh_TW: 摧毀所有派出鈦戰機的[[機庫口]]。

entries.source: The Death Star surface is covered with [[Turbolaser Towers]].  These batteries provide defense against small spacecraft such as starfighters.  The Death Star also carries a large contingent of [[TIE Fighters]] and [[Bombers]].  Both of these forces must be countered before we can launch our assault on the [[Death Star's Trench]].$  Your mission is to rendezvous at the Nav Buoy near the surface and
entries.target_zh_TW: 死星表面布滿了[[渦輪雷射砲塔]]。這些砲台負責防禦星際戰機之類的小型太空船。死星同時搭載了大批[[鈦戰機]]與[[轟炸機]]。在我們對[[死星溝槽]]發動攻擊之前，這兩股力量都必須先被壓制。$  你的任務是在靠近表面的導航浮標處會合，並

entries.source: destroy all the Turbolaser Towers within a [[two]] kilometer radius.  You must also destroy the four[[ Hangar Port exits]] that are camouflaged as simple supply containers.  From here, TIE squadrons exit the interior of the Death Star.$$>Good Luck!$ $>May the Force be with you!
entries.target_zh_TW: 摧毀半徑[[兩]]公里內所有的渦輪雷射砲塔。你還必須摧毀四座偽裝成普通補給貨櫃的[[機庫口出口]]。鈦戰機中隊會從這裡飛出死星內部。$$>祝你好運！$ $>願原力與你同在！

entries.source: All TIE fighter hangar ports destroyed in target area
entries.target_zh_TW: 目標區域內所有鈦戰機機庫口均已摧毀

entries.source: All laser towers cleared in target area
entries.target_zh_TW: 目標區域內的雷射塔已全數清除

entries.source:
Complete the final
assault on the Death 
Star by attacking the
Exhaust Port at the end
of the Trench.
entries.target_zh_TW:
攻擊溝槽盡頭的
排氣口，完成
對死星的
最後
突擊。

entries.source: In your [[X-wing]] follow the [[Nav Buoys]] to the Death Star Trench.
entries.target_zh_TW: 駕駛你的[[X翼戰機]]沿著[[導航浮標]]飛往死星溝槽。

entries.source: Turn [[left]] and [[descend]] into the Death Star Trench.
Beware of Imperial [[TIE fighters]].  They will send their best after you.
entries.target_zh_TW: 小心帝國[[鈦戰機]]。他們會派出精銳對付你。

entries.source: Follow the trench to the[[ Exhaust Port]].  Use your [[Proton Torpedoes]]!
entries.target_zh_TW: 沿著溝槽飛往[[排氣口]]。使用你的[[質子魚雷]]！

entries.source: Alliance scientists and engineers have analyzed the captured technical readouts of the Death Star.  They believe they have uncovered a [[weak spot]] that makes it vulnerable to attack.$  Along the equator of this huge artificial moon is a narrow trench.  At the end of this trench is a small [[exhaust outlet port]] which reaches all the way to the reactor core at the center of the battle station.
entries.target_zh_TW: 聯盟的科學家與工程師已分析了俘獲的死星技術資料。他們相信已找到一個使它易受攻擊的[[弱點]]。$  這座巨大人造衛星的赤道上有一道狹窄的溝槽。溝槽盡頭有一個小型[[排氣口]]，一路通往戰鬥太空站中心的反應爐核心。

entries.source: Our scientists believe that a[[ proton torpedo]] fired directly into this exhaust port could cause a [[chain reaction]] that would destroy the entire Death Star.$  [[Nav Buoys]] have been placed on the Death Star surface where previous attacks have cleared away the Turbolaser Towers.  Follow the buoys to the trench, turn [[left]] and descend into the trench.  Your R2D2 unit will then boost your engine speed.
entries.target_zh_TW: 我們的科學家相信，只要將一枚[[質子魚雷]]直接射入這個排氣口，就能引發[[連鎖反應]]，摧毀整座死星。$  先前的攻擊已清除了部分渦輪雷射砲塔，我們已在這些位置的死星表面布置了[[導航浮標]]。沿著浮標飛往溝槽，[[向左]]轉並下降進入溝槽。你的 R2D2 隨後會提升你的引擎速度。

entries.source: Your increased speed will improve your chances of surviving this hazardous mission.  Destroy the [[gun emplacements ]]on the floor and walls of the trench before they can fire at you.  The exhaust port is located at the end of the trench.  Watch your [[targeting computer]] for when the exhaust port comes into range of your proton torpedoes.$$>May the Force be with you!
entries.target_zh_TW: 提高的速度將增加你在這趟危險任務中的生還機會。在溝槽底部與兩側牆面的[[砲台]]開火之前摧毀它們。排氣口位於溝槽的盡頭。注意你的[[瞄準電腦]]，留意排氣口何時進入質子魚雷的射程。$$>願原力與你同在！

entries.source: You've hit the exhaust port, that was one in a million!
entries.target_zh_TW: 你擊中排氣口了，真是百萬分之一的機會！
